versions.content: function ChannelReestablished [SWS_DM_00313] Upstream: RS_AP_00120 , RS_AP_00121 , RS_AP_00122 , RS_Diag_04147 , RS_Diag_04168 virtual void ChannelReestablished ( GlobalChannelIdentifier global ChannelId) noexcept=0; Notification call from the given transport protocol channel, that it has been reestablished since the last (Re)Start from the UdsTransportProtocolHandler to which this channel belongs. To activate this notification a previous call to UdsTransportProtocolHandler::Notify Reestablishment() has to be done. See further documentation at UdsTransport ProtocolHandler::NotifyReestablishment().
